The 1954–55 season was [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s 52nd season in existence and the club's 24th consecutive season in the top flight of Spanish football.

Real Madrid successfully defended their league championship securing a fourth Primera División title.

==Summary==
The club won the second league championship in a row despite changes on the bench: a young Villalonga who was appointed manager of Real Madrid in the middle of the season replacing Enrique Fernandez Viola. Meanwhile, it was a great campaign for [[Francisco Gento]] and the club acquired Argentine [[Héctor Rial]] from the [[Nacional Montevideo]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en/news/2016/10/paco-gento-honorary-president-of-real-madrid|title=Paco Gento, Honorary President of Real Madrid|date=23 October 2016}}</ref><ref>[https://www.worldfootball.net/person/pe71061/hector-rial/ Worldfootball.net – Héctor Rial]</ref> an arrival to boost the offensive line. Argentine forward Alfredo Di Stéfano scored 25 goals playing another superb season. After its fourth ever league win (second in a row), the team proceeded to clinch the Latin Cup in June.<ref>{{cite news|last=Rimet|first=Pierre|date=4 January 1951|title=Cartas de Paris – Das pirâmides do Egito ao colosso do Maracanã, com o Sr. Jules Rimet|trans-title=Letters from Paris – From the pyramids of Egypt to the colossus of Maracanã, with Mr. Jules Rimet|url=http://memoria.bn.gov.br/DocReader/112518_01/38281|editor-last=Rodrigues Filho|editor-first=Mário|editor-link=Mário Filho|work=[[Jornal dos Sports]]|language=Portuguese|issue=6554|location=Rio de Janeiro, Brazil|page=5|access-date=2 June 2017|quote=A Taça Latina é uma competição criada pela F. I. F. A. a pedido dos quatro países que a disputam atualmente. Mas o Regulamento é feito por uma Comissão composta por membros das Federações concorrentes e de fato a F. I. F. A. não participa ativamente na organização}}</ref> However, in the [[1955 Copa del Generalisimo|Copa del Generalísimo]], without Di Stéfano (who still had not obtained his Spanish citizenship), Madrid were knocked out in the semi-finals by [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]]. Also, winning the domestic title gave Real Madrid the right to participate in the inaugural 1955–56 European Cup season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/teams/te1545/real-madrid/squad/ |title=Real Madrid » Squad 1954/1955 |publisher=worldfootball.net |access-date=11 June 2019}}</ref>
